privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how this website handles personal data when you use it.

controller.title: 1. Controller
controller.intro: The controller responsible for the processing of personal data is:
controller.text: If you have any questions regarding data protection or the processing of your personal data, you may contact us at any time using the contact details above.

collected.title: 2. Data You Provide
collected.text: When you use the RSVP form we process the personal data you enter, such as your first and last name, your email address, your telephone number, your chosen attendance options and, where applicable, the names of your guests. This data is used solely for planning and organising the wedding celebration.

analytics.title: 3. Analytics
analytics.text: With your consent we use an analytics service to measure how the website is used, so that we can improve it. Only anonymous usage data is processed, such as the pages opened and technical device characteristics. This data is not used to identify individual visitors.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.text: A language cookie (locale) remembers your selected language, and a consent cookie records your analytics decision. If you allow analytics, an anonymous identifier is stored in your browser. These are technical cookies that are not used for advertising.

storage.title: 5. Technical Data
storage.text: For the technical delivery of the website and its security, technical data such as your IP address may be processed. This is based on our legitimate interest in operating the website securely (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR).

legalBasis.title: 6. Legal Basis
legalBasis.text: We process personal data on the following legal bases: based on your consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR), for the performance of a contract or requested service (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR) and based on our legitimate interest in operating and securing the website (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR).

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.text: You have the right to request access to, rectification of, erasure of, restriction of processing of, and portability of your personal data. You may also object to processing and withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future. You may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.text: To exercise your rights or for any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@omnixys.com.

hero.subtitle: Yɛrebɛware
hero.quote:
"Me yɛ me dɔfo dea,
na me dɔfo nso yɛ me dea."

— Song of Solomon 6:3
hero.infoText: Bra ka yɛn ho na yɛmfa anigye nhyira yɛn dɔ na yɛnhyɛ yɛn akwantu ase. Yɛbɛdi ahurusi sɛ wobɛka yɛn ho wɔ da soronko yi.

ceremony.title: Aware Dwuma
ceremony.description: Asɔre fɛfɛ bi a atwa ho ahyia wɔ Stuttgart, a ɛma baabi a ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛyɛ kommyɛ ma aware dwuma no.

reception.title: Anigyede
reception.description: Yɛn anigyede no bɛkɔ so wɔ Anka Event a ɛwɔ Steinheim an der Murr – baabi a yɛbɛbom afɛɛdi na yɛn nnya anwummere dɛw.

ceremony.description: Bere a yɛn akwantu a yɛbɛbom ayɛ no fi ase ankasa.
ceremony.message: Yɛn ani gye sɛ mo ne yɛn bɛka yɛn yiw no.

photos.description: Ayekoo, ayɛyie ne mfonini wɔ aware dwuma no akyi.
photos.message: Nkae a edi kan a yɛne nnipa a yɛdɔ wɔn bɛkyɛ.

arrival.description: Bra ma yɛnnom, mmɔ nkɔmmɔ na yɛn nyinaa akwaaba.
arrival.message: Anadwo no fi ase bere a woadu hɔ.

dinner.description: Aduan, abusua, nnamfo ne anigye a yɛbɛbom akyɛ.
dinner.message: Aduan yɛ dɛ paa bere a yɛne mo bom di.

party.description: Nnwom, asaw ne anadwo bi a yɛren werɛ mfi da.

mapView.description: Aware dwuma, anigyede ne ahɔhodan a yɛkamfo no nyinaa wɔ map biako so. Sikakɔkɔɔ kwan no ka mmeae abien no bom.

mapView.fullscreen: Bue map no ma ɛnhyɛ screen no ma

car.title: Wɔ Kar Mu
car.details: Wobetumi afa A8 motorway so akɔ Stuttgart-Vaihingen. Di akyirikyiri kɔ Stuttgart-Vaihingen. Kar gyinabea wɔ hɔ bɛn asɔre no.

train.title: Wɔ Keteke Mu
train.details: Fa S-Bahn kɔ Stuttgart-Vaihingen station. Fi hɔ a, taxi anaa bus ketewa betumi de wo akɔ asɔre no.

parking.title: Kar Gyinabea
parking.details: Kar gyinabea wɔ hɔ bɛn asɔre no. Mesrɛ wo di kar gyinabea nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛwɔ asɔre no ho.

car.title: Wɔ Kar Mu
car.details: Anka Event a ɛwɔ Steinheim an der Murr betumi afa A81 motorway so akɔ hɔ. Fa Pleidelsheim/Murr exit na di akyirikyiri kɔ Murr/Steinheim.

train.title: Wɔ Keteke Mu
train.details: Fa S-Bahn kɔ Marbach am Neckar. Fi hɔ a, bɔs (line 460/461) anaa taxi kɔ Butakwa so de wo bɛkɔ Steinheim an der Murr.

parking.title: Kar Gyinabea
parking.details: Kar gyinabea wɔ hɔ wɔ location no ho wɔ Steinheim an der Murr.

dressCode.question: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehyɛ?
dressCode.answer: Dress code no yɛ elegant. Yɛsrɛ mo, mommfa orange, white ne emerald-green, efisɛ saa kɔla yi yɛ bridal team dea.

arrival.question: Bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ ahɔho ba?
arrival.answer: Yɛsrɛ sɛ mommra simma 30 ansa na aware dwuma no afi ase wɔ 12:30.

plusOne.question: Metumi de obi aka me ho aba?
plusOne.answer: Wo nkra no bɛkyerɛ sɛ obi betumi aka wo ho anaa. Sɛ biribi nna adi a, bisa yɛn.

children.question: Mmofra betumi aba?
children.answer: Wo nkra no ka obiara a yɛayɛ nhyehyɛe ama no ho. Yɛsrɛ sɛ bisa yɛn ansa na wode mmofra aka RSVP no ho. Mmofra a wonnii mfe 6 no betumi aba, na enhia sɛ wɔkyerɛw wɔn din soronko, efisɛ mpɛn pii no wɔtumi tena wɔn awofo nkyɛn. Nanso mmofra a wɔadi mfe 6 ne nea ɛboro saa no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔka wɔn ho wɔ RSVP mu, efisɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛma wɔn nkongua soronko.

dietary.question: Sɛ mintumi nni nnuan bi a, dɛn na menyɛ?
dietary.answer: Kyerɛw aduan a worentumi nni no wɔ wo RSVP mu na adidibea no atumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe.

late.question: Sɛ meka akyi a, dɛn na ɛbɛba?
late.answer: Yɛsrɛ sɛ fa komm bra mu na tie wɔn a wɔwɔ beae no akwankyerɛ.

parking.question: Ɛhe na metumi de kar asi?
parking.answer: Park wɔ asɔre no ho, na wubetumi nso apa gyinabea wɔ anigyede no ho wɔ Steinheim an der Murr.

publicTransport.question: Bɔs anaa keteke wɔ hɔ?
publicTransport.answer: Yiw. Stuttgart-Vaihingen ne Marbach am Neckar ne keteke gyinabea a ɛbɛn; fa bɔs anaa taxi kɔ Steinheim an der Murr.

charging.question: Kar charge beae wɔ bɛn?
charging.answer: Charge beae wɔ mpɔtam no. Yɛsrɛ sɛ hwɛ sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ ansa na woakɔ.

accessible.question: Wheelchair betumi akɔ beae no?
accessible.answer: Yɛsrɛ sɛ ka kyerɛ yɛn ansa na da no adu na yɛnkyerɛ wo kwan a ɛfata.

nearbyHotels.question: Ahɔhodan bɛn na ɛbɛn?
nearbyHotels.answer: Ahɔhodan fã no kyerɛ mmeae a yɛankasa yɛapaw a ɛbɛn anigyede no, ne kwan tenten ne akwantu bere.

recommendedHotels.question: Ahɔhodan bɛn na mokamfo?
recommendedHotels.answer: Yiw. Yɛapaw ahɔhodan a ɛfata na yɛde wɔn wɛbsaet, dan gye ne map links aka ho.

hotelDistance.question: Ahɔhodan no ne beae no ntam ware sɛn?
hotelDistance.answer: Wubehu kwan tenten ne akwantu bere a ɛkɔ aware dwuma ne anigyede no wɔ ahɔhodan biara ho.

hotelTravel.question: Kwan wɔ hotel ne beae no ntam?
hotelTravel.answer: Taxi ne kar a mobɛbom afa yɛ mmerɛw. Yɛnnyaa shuttle nhyehyɛe a wɔagye atom.

photographer.question: Mfoninitwafo bɛba?
photographer.answer: Yiw, mfoninitwafo a ɔyɛ adwuma no bɛkyere da no. Momma no kwan wɔ bere titiriw no mu.

guestPhotos.question: Ahɔho betumi atwa mfonini?
guestPhotos.answer: Yiw, gye sɛ wɔaka sɛ yɛmfa telefon nni dwuma wɔ bere bi mu.

dancing.question: Nnwom ne asaw bɛba?
dancing.answer: Yiw. Aduan no akyi, yɛbɛto nnwom, asaw na yɛn ani agye.

endTime.question: Bere bɛn na anigyede no bɛba awiei?
endTime.answer: Yɛayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ aponto no bɛkɔ so akosi anadwo akyiri.

contact.question: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa a, hena na mefrɛ no?
contact.answer: Fa nkitahodi a ɛwɔ wo nkra no mu anaa frɛ awarefo no.

weather.question: Sɛ osu tɔ anaa wim yɛ bɔne a, dɛn na ɛbɛba?
weather.answer: Anigyede no bɛkɔ so. Dan ne beae a wɔakata so wɔ hɔ, na yɛbɛka nsakrae biara akyerɛ mo.

footer.message: Yɛda mo ase sɛ mo ne yɛn redi ahurisie.
footer.thankYouTitle: Yɛda mo ase sɛ mo ne yɛn redi ahurisie.
footer.thankYouBody:
Mo dɔ, mo mpaebɔ ne mo ba ha ama saa da yi ayɛ nea yɛren werɛ mfi.
Yɛda ase sɛ yɛrefi saa akwantu foforo yi ase wɔ nnipa a yɛdɔ wɔn paa mu.
footer.verseLine1: "Baabi a wobɛkɔ no, ɛhɔ na me nso mɛkɔ;
footer.verseLine2: baabi a wobɛtena no, ɛhɔ na me nso mɛtena."
footer.imageAlt: Caleb ne Rachel reyɛ anigye wɔ aware mfonini a ɛyɛ hyew mu

rsvpSuccess.title: Yɛda Wo Ase
rsvpSuccess.message1: Yɛda wo ase sɛ wode wo RSVP abrɛ yɛn.
rsvpSuccess.message2: Yɛn nsafoa kuw no redwen mmuaeɛ nyinaa ho bere a yɛrehyehyɛ aware no yiye.
rsvpSuccess.message3: Yɛda wo ase paa wɔ wo boasetɔ ne wo dɔ a wode rebɛdi anigye da yi ho.
rsvpSuccess.contactText: Sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa bi a, wubetumi ne yɛn adi nkitaho
